entities.summary: Ernst Kolman or Arnošt Yaromirovich Kolman ; 6 December 1892 – 22 January 1979) was a Marxist propagandist, an ideological enforcer in Soviet science, and an informant during the Stalinist purges. At the age of 84 he sought asylum in Sweden and published a retraction of his previous activity.
